verdict.rationale: Reflect exposes some automation surfaces: saved custom AI prompts, deep links, a limited REST API, and Zapier integrations. So versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows automations or custom prompts can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. Note history (reverting notes to any point in time) covers note content, not automations, and the API docs explicitly document no versioning policy.
